originalTitle: Watch: Blood donors get a Halloween fright in Thailand
summary: Thai Red Cross workers dressed up as part of a Halloween-themed blood drive in the country's capital Bangkok.
content:
Thai Red Cross workers dressed up as part of a Halloween-themed blood drive in the country's capital Bangkok.

The charity gave free themed t-shirts to donors during the event, and said it expected turnout to more than double compared to a typical Saturday.
chineseTitle: 观看：献血者在泰国遭遇万圣节惊吓
chineseSummary: 泰国红十字会工作人员盛装打扮，参加该国首都曼谷举行的万圣节主题献血活动。
chineseContent:
泰国红十字会工作人员盛装打扮，参加该国首都曼谷举行的万圣节主题献血活动。

该慈善机构在活动期间向捐赠者免费赠送了主题 T 恤，并表示预计参与人数将比平常周六增加一倍以上。
